targets.envelope: One bounded action <= 64 KiB; excludes durable I/O/helper time; hardware and load must be pinned before activation.
One declared serving model/batch/context/tap profile; includes capture and transfer, not helper inference.
Excludes explicitly referenced payload/trace objects; all queues separately bounded.
H1 experiment only; matched compute, utility and preregistered per-stratum noninferiority; not a deployment safety guarantee.

Ratio of control-plane plus evidence-plane cost to the actor's own inference cost per useful completed task, reported unconditional and attack-conditioned under a declared monitoring contract. The founding essay argues a serious deployment may spend as much on control as on the model; the target is an allocatable budget, not a safety result, and can never be met by lowering the control contract.
